description: This file defines a React component class 'NoteView' for rendering and managing a note editing interface, including handling state, lifecycle, user interactions, and integration with other components and services.

classes.name: NoteView
classes.description: A React component class for viewing and editing notes, managing state, lifecycle, user interactions, and rendering the note interface.

methods.name: sortAlphabetically
methods.description: Sorts an array of SNComponent objects alphabetically by their name property.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the current component state.

methods.name: note
methods.description: Getter for the current note item from the controller.

methods.name: shouldComponentUpdate
methods.description: Determines whether the component should re-render based on state changes.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Initializes component, registers keyboard shortcuts, observers, and loads data.

methods.name: setPlainEditorRef
methods.description: Sets the reference to the PlainEditor component.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Handles updates after component re-rendering, especially changes in protected warning display.

methods.name: onNoteInnerChange
methods.description: Handles internal changes to the note, updating state and triggering UI updates.

methods.name: componentWillUnmount
methods.description: Cleans up observers and component state before unmounting.

methods.name: onAppLaunch
methods.description: Handles actions when the app launches, such as streaming items.

methods.name: onAppEvent
methods.description: Handles various application events to update UI and state accordingly.

methods.name: getSecondsElapsedSinceLastEdit
methods.description: Calculates seconds since the last note modification.

methods.name: hideProtectedNoteIfInactive
methods.description: Hides protected overlay if note is inactive for a specified duration.

methods.name: startNoteProtectionInactivityTimer
methods.description: Starts a timer to hide protected overlay after inactivity.

methods.name: clearNoteProtectionInactivityTimer
methods.description: Clears the inactivity timer.

methods.name: authorizeAndDismissProtectedWarning
methods.description: Authorizes user to view protected note and dismisses overlay.

methods.name: streamItems
methods.description: Streams item updates from the application.

methods.name: createComponentViewer
methods.description: Creates a component viewer for a given SNComponent.

methods.name: editorComponentViewerRequestsReload
methods.description: Reloads the editor component viewer, optionally forcing reload.

methods.name: debounceReloadEditorComponent
methods.description: Debounced call to reload the editor component.

methods.name: destroyCurrentEditorComponent
methods.description: Destroys the current editor component viewer.

methods.name: reloadEditorComponent
methods.description: Reloads the editor component, handling protected overlay and template notes.

methods.name: hasAvailableExtensions
methods.description: Checks if there are extensions available for the current note.

methods.name: showSavingStatus
methods.description: Displays saving status indicator.

methods.name: showAllChangesSavedStatus
methods.description: Displays 'all changes saved' status.

methods.name: showErrorStatus
methods.description: Displays error status, optionally with custom message.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the note status with optional delay.

methods.name: cancelPendingSetStatus
methods.description: Cancels any pending status update timeout.

methods.name: onTitleEnter
methods.description: Handles Enter key press in title input to blur and focus editor.

methods.name: onTitleChange
methods.description: Handles title input change, saves new title.

methods.name: focusTitle
methods.description: Focuses the title input element.

methods.name: setShowProtectedOverlay
methods.description: Shows or hides the protected overlay warning.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes the note, with confirmation and handling for locked or template notes.

methods.name: performNoteDeletion
methods.description: Performs deletion of a note via application mutator.

methods.name: onPanelResizeFinish
methods.description: Handles completion of panel resize, updating preferences.

methods.name: reloadSpellcheck
methods.description: Reloads spellcheck state for the note.

methods.name: reloadPreferences
methods.description: Reloads user preferences related to editor and UI.

methods.name: reloadStackComponents
methods.description: Reloads and manages stack components and their viewers.

methods.name: stackComponentExpanded
methods.description: Checks if a stack component is expanded.

methods.name: toggleStackComponent
methods.description: Enables or disables a stack component for the note.

methods.name: registerKeyboardShortcuts
methods.description: Registers keyboard command handlers.

methods.name: ensureNoteIsInsertedBeforeUIAction
methods.description: Ensures the note is inserted before performing UI actions.

methods.name: onPlainFocus
methods.description: Handles focus event on plain editor.

methods.name: onPlainBlur
methods.description: Handles blur event on plain editor.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the entire note view UI, including header, editor, overlays, and component stack.
